summary: Deploy the new Saleor version with only Django state changes (migration state_only), retire the old version, then drop the note column from the account_user table to complete removal.
write_consistency: The old version continues to read and write the note column until retire_old; the new version does not access the note field. The column is removed only after the old version is retired, ensuring no concurrent writes fail.

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version (old) so that only the new version handles traffic.
Remove the note column from the account_user table.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
